title: 4.5.1: Random `load_steps=0` entry being added to material .tres file
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in 4.5.1 mono

### System information

Godot v4.5.1.stable.mono - Windows 11 (build 22631) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - integrated Intel(R) Iris(R) Xe Graphics (Intel Corporation; 32.0.101.7082) - 13th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-1355U (12 threads) - 15.68 GiB memory

### Issue description

I have one .tres material file that keeps randomly getting a `load_steps=0` entry added to it.  This is so weird, because I was under the impression that `load_steps` is only applicable to .tscn files.  This `load_steps` entry will then randomly be deleted after working on the project for a bit, creating some git change spam.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Add the following file to your project:
BlackVoid.tres
```
[gd_resource type="StandardMaterial3D" format=3 uid="uid://dbvtf6hqffg6e"]

[resource]
shading_mode = 0
albedo_color = Color(0, 0, 0, 1)
disable_receive_shadows = true
```

2. Start working on your project.  Write some code, playtest it, switch git branches, etc.  Just do things that you would normally do during development.  ~~You also need to pretend like you're not trying to reproduce it; the bug is sentient and hides when it realizes you're trying to fix it~~

3. Watch in horror as your file now looks like this:
```
[gd_resource type="StandardMaterial3D" load_steps=0 format=3 uid="uid://dbvtf6hqffg6e"]

[resource]
shading_mode = 0
albedo_color = Color(0, 0, 0, 1)
disable_receive_shadows = true

```

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

N/A
